title: Keep the Go inference transport backoff capped after a prolonged Ollama outage
notes: A local Go check reproduced a negative backoff at 30 consecutive transport failures because the duration overflows before the cap is applied.
done_when: Exercise at least 80 consecutive transport failures and verify that the delay stays at 30 minutes after reaching the cap.
result: Keep the Go inference transport backoff capped after a prolonged Ollama outage
evidence: go test ./internal/node verifies the 30-minute transport backoff cap through 85 consecutive failures and the reset after a successful attempt.
